title: 15 Best Crete Wedding Venues
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget
notes: NEW venue guide (not a refresh). Island deep dive below the 20-venue Greece guide draft (content/posts/greece-wedding-venues/, which lists only two Crete venues: Elounda Beach Hotel & Villas and Nana Princess; reuse their facts from that source pack, re-checked live, with fresh wording). Model: content/posts/greece-wedding-venues and lake-como-villa-wedding-exclusive-use: every venue verified on its own official site; house rules a venue does not publish written as 'Not published' with one line per section that the Wedded Advisor confirms them in writing, no VERIFY marker, listed on a booking checklist; no prices or fees.

OVERLAP: link map has no Crete pages. SEO checks whether any site page (including the Greece hub /destinations/europe/greece) ranks for 'crete wedding venues' and variants (chania, elounda, heraklion, rethymno, crete villa wedding). Link the Greece venues guide /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-venues (draft) both ways, the Greece hub, and /expert-advice/greek-wedding-traditions once.

AUTHORITY RULE (content-system/brand/voice-guide.md 'Write with authority'): no research talk in the copy (what we could or couldn't find, trace or confirm; our sources or method; what the internet says; myths sections; 'you will often read'). Customs without a strong source are written as living practice in a confident voice ('Many couples...'), never with a meaning or origin stated as fact. 'Often told' at most once per post, never 'it is often told that'. No hedge stacking: cite a source once by link; date legal and travel facts once per section. Source gaps go in the run report only. No per-line source credits (never 'Britannica describes', 'the museum holds', 'the study records'). No myth-busting lines ('you will often read', 'confident dates').

Venue selection (brief sets 15): spread across Elounda and Agios Nikolaos (Lasithi), Hersonissos and the Heraklion coast, Rethymno, Chania and the west, the south coast if venues qualify. Mix of luxury resorts, private villas offering exclusive use, and estates or wineries that host weddings. Inclusion rule: the venue's own official site says it hosts weddings. Phaea Blue (ex Blue Palace) has no weddings page (Greece pack fact_112); Domes of Elounda lists events but no weddings page (fact_311): include only if a weddings page is found. Unconfirmable candidates are swapped; do not pad to 15 (if fewer qualify, the title count changes and the person is told).

Each venue entry, from official pages only: location and setting; ceremony options (on-site ceremony, chapel, symbolic or legal only where the venue says); capacity where published; exclusive use where offered; guest rooms where published; one standout detail. House rules (curfew, minimum nights, music) as 'Not published' plus the Advisor line.

Supporting sections (short, sourced): comparing venues like for like (table); choosing an area (east vs west Crete) as practical guidance; getting there (Heraklion and Chania airports, transfers) from official airport or tourism sources; season only as an official, tourism or venue source states it; legal in brief from the Embassy Athens and Smartraveller facts in content/posts/greek-wedding-traditions/03-source-pack*.json and content/posts/greece-wedding-venues/03-source-pack.json, re-checked, linking the Greece guide's legal section; Smartraveller Greece checked live.

Sources: venues' official websites and wedding pages, visitgreece.gr, incrediblecrete.gr (Region of Crete), official airport sites, Smartraveller, the Australian Embassy Athens. Never competitor wedding sites, directories, vendor blogs, review sites or Wikipedia.

Images: placeholders only; every venue image must be licensed or from a venue press kit with permission (permission emails drafted only, never sent); venue images are never AI; competitor images reference-only.

Speed: Apify web-fetch (parallel) and DataForSEO. Fact-check as 3 parallel batches (A: Elounda, Agios Nikolaos, east Crete, fact_01+; B: Hersonissos, Heraklion, Rethymno, fact_100+; C: Chania, west Crete and practical sections, fact_200+), 15 min HARD by the clock, start no new reads after the limit, save after every 3 facts, separate scratch folders crv_a/crv_b/crv_c; self_qa.confidence a number; must_include_coverage objects with covered_by arrays; never retry a declined call.
Headings must not contain pasted keywords in brackets.
Do not use 'from first idea to the last dance' or 'last dance'; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; no Wedded Privileges or inclusions beyond brand facts.

Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; no prices or amounts; venue names allowed (it is a venue guide), no other vendor names; business details deferred; Australian English; no em dashes.
